notes.title: The flight to the resort has been slightly delayed! ⌛
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

[b]We were planning on releasing the game a few days ago, but had to move the release date a little bit - SEX, BEACH & GIRLS ⛱ 💦 is coming out this Saturday. [/b]

We decided a few things here and there require more polishing and quality assurance before we're ready to show you what we've been working on all this time. Prepare to spend your vacation with the most stunning hotties possible in the little resort town near the beautiful beach - manage your time and resources, get to know various intriguing characters with their unique backstories and hobbies, steal their hearts and make this vacation linger in your memory for long after you leave! 

[b]As a little bonus, and since we had to move the release date - there'll be a little surprise right when we release the game, so try to be attentive and don't forget to wishlist the game - waiting will be over soon! We're looking forward to meeting you on the shore![/b]

With best regards to everyone, your Pocket Rocket Studio 🚀

notes.title: Is it me or is it kind of hot here? 🥵
notes.notes:
Summer is in full swing, let's go visit the beach! We're currently in the midst of developing the [b]SEX, BEACH & GIRLS[/b] ⛱ 💦. 
We're trying to capture and preserve some of that summer atmosphere - put yourself in the shoes of a regular guy on vacation trying to have some unhinged fun and get the most out of his time there. 
Let us know if you have any specific questions about the game, characters or anything else - we'll be glad to hear your thoughts and suggestions! 

[b]Also, let us know if any of you are interested in an interactive event in our Discord channel - if you guys would be interested, we can host quiz/contest/etc. to let you win game keys/early renders etc.![/b]

 Prepare yourself for stunning artwork, dynamic storytelling, engaging characters and activities and an atmosphere of summer chill!

Let us know what's on your mind and don't forget to [h1]wishlist![/h1]
